Ben: morning check-in — quick pipeline + sec asks
Ben: what I did: prepped demo for CardinalCare, looped in solutions eng for infra Qs
Ben: blockers: CardinalCare asked for SSO + KMS details, wants SOC2 evidence, and a timeline for private deploy (they're regulated)
Alice: update: followed up on SOC2 docs with security team yesterday, should have the package by EOD Weds :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alice: for SSO, we can offer SAML + OIDC; Mateo is owner for implementation details
Mateo: noted. I can draft the SSO integration notes and sample SAML metadata. ETA tomorrow afternoon.
Priya: legal asked for sample DPA + data residency clause. I can pull the templates and send to Ben by lunchtime.
Ben: thanks — can we also confirm expected latency SLAs for their POC? they want <200ms 99th for embeddings route
Mateo: latency depends on model + region. For eu-west we can hit <200ms with smaller models and dedicated pool. I'll put numbers in the doc.
Alice: security ask: CardinalCare wants verification that KV cache is not persisted outside GPUs, plus details on KMS rotation.
Mateo: KV cache details: ephemeral in-GPU memory, no disk persistence by default. For KMS rotation, we use Cloud KMS integration — will add exact rotation schedule and key access policy.
Ben: pipeline numbers: 3 active enterprise opportunities this week (CardinalCare, VantageRx, BlueHarbor). CardinalCare highest ACV.
Priya: BlueHarbor flagged a budget review — possible delay to next quarter. VantageRx needs a POC for 2 weeks, security is lighter there.
Ben: asks for eng: can someone spare 4h next Thu for a technical deep-dive with CardinalCare infra team? they're hands-on.
Mateo: I can do that slot — count me in.
Alice: I'll book a 1hr pre-call to sync on talking points and ship the SOC2 pack before the deep-dive.
Ben: sales-bot: created tracking card for CARDINAL-POC with checklist (SOC2, SSO, DPA, demo).
sales-bot: CARDINAL-POC created — assignees: Ben, Mateo, Alice, Priya. Due: 2026-04-10
Ben: final note: if anyone has objections to sharing the SOC2 redacted report, flag here — otherwise I'll send to customer under NDA. :thumbsup:
Alice: no objections.
Mateo: all good from eng.
Priya: legal ok with redacted copy behind NDA.
Ben: thanks team — I'll update CRM and follow up with CardinalCare.
Ben: out.
